findings.location: Worker lifecycle and Wrangler; Authentication, cookies, and bootstrap; deployment documentation
findings.problem: Refresh-cookie authentication is not browser-feasibility-guaranteed when a Vercel-hosted frontend calls workers.dev or api.mtechcare.com cross-site, because modern third-party-cookie blocking can prevent storage or sending despite correct CORS and SameSite=None.
findings.fix: Require a same-site custom frontend hostname such as app.mtechcare.com with api.mtechcare.com, prefer an API host-only refresh cookie, and gate cutover on a real-browser login/reload/refresh/logout test; otherwise separately design a non-cookie refresh and CSRF model.

findings.location: Password feasibility and login abuse control amendment; public service-request routes
findings.problem: The design asserts a separate public-service-request rate bucket but does not define endpoint coverage, operation-specific keys, thresholds, windows, Retry-After, cleanup, or whether blocked calls avoid service-request D1 operations.
findings.fix: Specify and test distinct HMAC operation buckets and exact limits for both POST /api/service-request and GET /api/service-request/by-mobile, pre-domain-operation generic 429 behavior, bounded expiry cleanup, concurrency, and bucket separation.

findings.problem: One global cursor combined with current-permission filtering can skip an event forever when mixed event types advance the cursor and the admin later gains permission to the skipped type.
findings.fix: Either persist fixed-at-publication per-admin notification recipients (recommended) or maintain separate persisted cursors per typed permission stream; define and test permission grant/revoke/regrant and account lifecycle behavior across three admins.

findings.location: Fresh D1 schema contract date and TS macros
findings.problem: Real DATE and canonical UTC RFC3339 storage are required but the exact canonical timestamp form and implementable SQLite checks are not defined.
findings.fix: Lock DATE to YYYY-MM-DD with shared Gregorian validation and TS to 24-byte Date.toISOString output, specify SQL shape checks, and test leap days, impossible dates, offset normalization, and round trips.

findings.location: Password feasibility and login abuse control amendment
findings.problem: The process-constant dummy v1 password record could be interpreted as a literal source-controlled hash, conflicting with broad no-password/hash repository hygiene.
findings.fix: Generate random dummy salt and comparison bytes at isolate initialization, construct the record only in memory, never log/snapshot it, and test equal derivation work for unknown accounts.
